target_rule_evaluation.rule_name: Heavy TCP Host Scan On Fixed Port
target_rule_evaluation.mathematical_explanation: Under Verdictum AI mathematical governance, selective accuracy is defined as (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN). Because the model safely abstained on all 33 evaluated incidents (decisive count = 0), and because 0 verified TP records exist in the telemetry (One-Class Dataset), both the accuracy denominator and recall denominator are 0. In strict accordance with ISO/IEC 42001 and Verdictum AI safety standards, this metric is NOT_MEASURABLE (null) and must never be reported as 0% or 100%.

configuration_a.name: Configuration A — Common SOC Baseline
configuration_a.description: Evaluates incidents using standard common SOC instructions without rule-specific policy tuning.
configuration_a.findings: Without rule-specific guidance, the model struggled to parse FortiSIEM log formats, hallucinated non-existent firewall interfaces, and had to be caught by guardrails.

configuration_b.name: Configuration B — Current Approved Policy v7
configuration_b.description: Active baseline policy with strict evidence contract requirements (detection.threshold, network.tcp_flags).
configuration_b.findings: 100% abstention. Strict contract required TCP flags which are absent in FortiGate traffic logs. Dropped events[0] timestamp/protocol during compaction. Model refused FP without RAG precedent.

configuration_c.name: Configuration C — Candidate Draft Policy v8
configuration_c.description: Candidate policy with corrected evidence contracts, relaxed flag requirements, and anti-hallucination prompts.
configuration_c.findings: Significant qualitative leap: Grounded claims jumped from 0% to 100% (16/16). Hallucinations dropped from 5 to 0. Trust score increased from 60 to 81.2. Preserved 100% abstention safely due to 4096 context budget ceiling and 0 RAG maintenance ticket precedents.

v7_vs_v8_statistical_delta.policy_recommendation: Maintain v7 as APPROVED. Keep v8 as DRAFT until GPU context window is expanded to 8192/16384 tokens in AIS 2.3.
